description: Start or restart identity verification (KYC) — the first setup step before RealOpen can issue a crypto Proof of Funds letter for a real estate offer. If a previous session exists that was incomplete, denied, or expired, this creates a new one. Returns a secure hosted verification URL the user opens in their browser; do not collect sensitive identity details in chat.

force_new.description: Force a new verification session even if one is pending (use after denial or expiry)

name: start_identity_verification

previous_status.description: The prior session status if this call is restarting a stale session

verification_url.description: Stripe Identity URL the user opens in their browser. Present when status=redirect_required.
